rights: Public domain map data; source notices remain distinct from portfolio code licensing.
notes: Natural Earth uses de facto boundaries and includes territories and disputed areas. This pinned snapshot is not a statement of recognition or a live authoritative border service.
Province features are heterogeneous administrative levels, not an assertion that every region is legally equivalent to a US state.
Countries lacking a province feature receive a labeled country fallback, not an invented province.
Routes are candidates for inspection, not a validated full-match movement ruleset. Some cardinal sectors may be empty. Diagonal candidates can skip two edge steps.
Population values are source estimates of differing vintages, not current census rankings.
Ocean components separated by land within a grid cell are distinct spaces. The ocean mask follows the country-layer land union; residual inland water may remain.
